title: Product and bounded ownership
summary: Standalone side-by-side visual website editing. Rasenfalcon nine-page website is a qualified fixture, not a mandatory CMS dependency. Repository source directory packages/alchemy_website_publisher_v0.3; independently managed sphere lives at spheres/website_publisher_gopher_sphere_v0.1.

Publishing is never granted by preview, export, NoSQL persistence or a label saying approved.
